notes.title: Untold Tales Presents - Blossom into Gaming Bliss
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/ff5c1af5dc7fe7570121d3c80d993df2fcb41e7a.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings, fellow adventurers![/h3]
[h3]Join us as we embrace the enchantment of this season, guided by the playful gaming sprite. Discover upcoming releases, essential must-haves, and timeless classics from Untold Tales, all tailored for your home entertainment. 
Let the joyous gaming journey bloom anew![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/df864d4d04cf4aa448996217a57ee2ca496e5e69.png[/img]
[b]Since our last episode of Untold Tales Presents, we’ve released the following titles:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1941410/The_Cub/
[h3]Navigate a neon-lit apocalypse in a fusion of Jungle Book meets The Armageddon, brought to you by the creators of Golf Club Nostalgia and Highwater. Parkour through the remains of humanity as a hunted child, while catchy end-of-day tunes and curious survivor stories play on the radio.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2551920/Tools_Up_Ultimate_Edition/
[h3]Dive into chaos-filled, local couch-coop extravaganza, all about renovating homes and the outdoors. It comes with all updates, content, and DLC in one package, supporting up to 4 players.[/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/3613a9f06b81f58ac9909d2037ffde00bd1b7844.png[/img]
[h3]And soon we will have a new task for you - lift the box and ensure its safe journey out of the factory. 
How difficult could it be, right? 
But the real test awaits amidst the conveyor belt chaos of Ready, Steady, Ship! 
Team up with a friend and prepare to step up the pace for the imminent release!

[b]Wishlist and Play the Demo now[/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225610/Ready_Steady_Ship/


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/32301091668e63686dd894417f7dfcf5636de657.png[/img]
[h3]The sun's shining, the birds are chirping, and the Steam Spring Sale 2024 is in full swing! It's the perfect time to cozy up indoors and lose yourself in some epic gaming adventures brought to you by Untold Tales.[/h3]

[b][h3][url=https://bit.ly/UT_SpringSale] CHECK OUR BLOOMING GAMING DEALS NOW[/url][/h3][/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/731b461d83967476b1a22c9571c199a26a676e51.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1227650/BangOn_Balls_Chronicles/
[h3]Bang-On Balls: Chronicles is now available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S! Unlock the full potential of the next-gen consoles, making your escapades smoother and more visually stunning than ever before! This update is completely free for anyone who already owns Bang-On Balls: Chronicles on PS4 or Xbox One[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1403650/Everdream_Valley/
[h3]Dream Bigger Together update brings up to 4-player coop to Everdream Valley. Do everything you can solo but together from exploring, building, caring for animals, or just seeking out your next adventure.[/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777290/Boti_Byteland_Overclocked__Bitosaurus_DLC/
[h3]Jump in, transform into a fearsome Bitosaurus, and roar your way through Byteland![/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/8148f0de522ffe890fef4ee7c459dd244be1376d.png[/img]
[h3]We encourage you to put on your headphones just like you would put on a radio helmet, and get ready to immerse yourself in the world of The Cub with Radio Nostalgia from Mars broadcasts:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=Lvataz4WuvU;full][/previewyoutube]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41232016/5646cc8398bafe936085cc7e326f32cc10ec5329.png[/img]
[h3]Thank you for embarking on this brief adventure with us, and we look forward to having you accompany us on future journeys. As we anticipate and prepare for upcoming exciting news, stay connected with us on our social media platforms:[/h3]

[h3][url=https://www.facebook.com/untoldtalesgames]Facebook[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/UntoldTalesHQ]Twitter[/url]  / [url=https://www.instagram.com/untoldtaleshq/]Instagram[/url] / [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@untoldtales.games]TikTok[/url] / [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UChrqRdrw-oNv-AXVMOwa1yw]YouTube[/url][/h3]

notes.title: DEMO PATCH v0.1.2⭐
notes.content:
Dear explorers!

We recently proudly announced our new project I NEED SPACE to a positive reception at GCA & GDC in San Francisco! We heard your feedback & suggestions - and now we present the latest patch addressing some of the notes given by those of you who playtested, DM or commented on our pages :)

[b]Demo Patch v 0.1.2 [/b]all for more interstellar fun times; 

such as naming the Home Planet & the Cosmicat! ⭐️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/f2dad0a987ef72d1952c194d4d99664f969f6b82.gif[/img]

More visually populated galaxy! ⭐️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/1d104c1218ade79c7f2a57afecf681194b9001bf.gif[/img]

& many more! ⭐️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/900c92d0f125faf95c7e81e22ca72fc6382d65f2.gif[/img]

 💫Updates💫 
[i]- You can now customize the name for the Home planet and the Cosmicat.
- Updated space background visuals with Nebula, Distant planets/ debris & story-related landmarks.
- Added grid to the Constellation mode.
- In-game Constellation can now be saved & viewed in EXTRAS.
- Totems now have dialogues.
- Players can now interact with the Tutus (The small rock creatures).
- Improvements to the player movement and jump physics.
- More minimalistic control scheme for both gamepad & keyboard.
- Improved Journal UI.
- Improved Gameplay UI.
- Cutscenes are now skippable.[/i]

✨Write your Ramadhan greetings in the stars!✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/a2be7479f367e10bff7c64345e0b2ed25af2013f.gif[/img]

Try out the enhanced Constellation Drawing and let your imagination run wild! Write your own special Ramadhan greetings in the stars and submit them to us.

We'll compile all the constellations and post them on our social media pages next week!

---

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2337180/I_NEED_SPACE/

Thank you for your feedback, it really helps us improve! If there’s anything else you’d like to see in I NEED SPACE, shoot us a PM or tell us in Discord [b]#game-suggestions-[/b]📕

May this month bring you closer to your loved ones, and may it be filled with countless moments of peace, reflection, and gratitude.

Laters Explorers!
- El & the Khayalan Arts crew

notes.title: SAMUDRA | Patch (V1.2) is now available!
notes.content:
In this week's patch, we addressed some of the issues that had been reported via emails, DMs, and also from our own observations during your streams for the past 3 weeks. Thank you for all the feedback!

[b]Global/menu:[/b]
- Improved Chapter Selection with Chapter description
(Accessible after finishing the game 1 time)

[b]Chapter II:[/b]
- Fixed missing SFX at POD Boss
- FIxed Shadow caster at puzzle room 1
- Fixed glitch animation by Salaryman during in the pipe room
- Fixed foreground asset layers at the secret helmet grave
- Fixed glitch during Salaryman alert animation

[b]Chapter III:[/b]
- Fixed Airflow particle FX error at the POD room
- Fixed stones not breaking glitch
- Fixed gamelan puzzle controller issue

[b]Chapter IV:[/b]
- Fixed broken OST during the parasite chase
- Fixed the ghost SFX at the beginning of scenes
- Fixed Parasite chase glitch where the player can get stuck during the 2nd part of the chase
- Fixed dumbo octopus freezing glitch 
- Added reaction animation during the ending QTE at the parasite boss

[b]Chapter V:[/b]
- Fixed broken OST/ SFX at multiple locations
- Added in missing SFX & volume adjustments at multiple locations 
- Fixed final chase sequence QTE spam glitch 
- Fixed Layering issue during final chase squence
- Fixed glitch player freezing during death animation 
- Fixed glitch during the pipe air flow sequence
- Fixed controller issue at the lift UI

[b]Puffer Rooms:[/b]
-  Fixed player freezing issue at Puffer room #4

---

We are still working on a couple more patches to make this an even more immersive deep-sea journey - thank you for the patience and have a lovely week ahead!

Laters!
El | Khayalan Arts

notes.title: SAMUDRA | Week 1 Patch (V1.1) is now available!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/61c5f334ec27b39932bb5288479de34e3e88c65f.jpg[/img]
Week one is over and the reports are in! We spent some time tackling the following bugs/ glitches, as well as revising some things to improve the overall experience of the game:

[b]Global:[/b]
- Fixed player walking backward glitch (moonwalk)
- Fixed BGM error that appears in the main menu after exiting the game
- Fixed player death animation & camera error during pitfall
- Fixed error & holes in certain foreground artwork

[b]Chapter II:[/b]
- Revised trash system in the pipe section to prevent overflow of trash and results in glitching
- Revised design path in the pipe section by adding more light sources to guide the player

[b]Chapter III:[/b]
- Disabled error demo message that showed up during one of the levels

[b]Chapter IV:[/b]
- Fixed Dumbo Octopus freezing glitch during the pipe animation sequence

[b]Chapter V:[/b]
- Fixed player freeze glitch during the puzzle music box at
- Fixed QTE sequence glitches during the final chase sequence
- Fixed player walking backward glitch (moonwalk) after pulling a puzzle box
- Revised missing art of broken machine at the end of the level

[b]Puffer Rooms:[/b]
- Fixed a player freeze glitch that appears upon entering Puffer altar room
- Fixed camera zoom issue when performing overheat and moving the player too early in Puffer room
- Fixed player freeze glitch when interacting with switches in Puffer room
- Fixed random spawn point error after exiting Puffer room
- Fixed pufferfish clipping animation in Puffer room #4
- Revised Puffer room ending animation in Puffer room #2 & Puffer room #4
- Revised missing art that disappears after clearing puffer #2

[b]Achievements:[/b]
- Fixed error of missing achievements ( previously acquired achievements will be updated automatically by visiting the gallery menu)

Thank you for letting us know of these issues - please do not hesitate to DM us on any of our social media or post a comment on Steam to report any more findings of bugs or glitches, or just to let us know your overall experience with SAMUDRA :D

Laters!
El | Khayalan Arts

notes.title: July Splashes 🌊🌊🌊
notes.content:
[b]#PlasticFreeJuly[/b] is here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/9c14549278002a35cb229f690d8d9d7cc3afd7ce.jpg[/img]

I'm taking this opportunity to announce our July Splashes and summarized the news that we shared on our social media this week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/9166ad39be91c64a9363650a1278a6184fd7558c.jpg[/img]

July is going to be an exciting month for SAMUDRA! We're picking up the marketing campaigns and efforts to share the project prior to our release date (soon to be announced!). We are also organizing a [b]PUBLIC STEAM PLAYTEST[/b] - so stay tuned if you are interested in joining this event :D 

---

We started this week out with the announcement of our involvement in the [b]Games For Change Festival 2021. [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/cbbe05d3ab690aadcc066904941af00713882819.png[/img]

[b]Feel free to check it out here[/b] 👉 https://2021gamesforchangevirtualfestiva.sched.com/event/k6db 

[b]RSVP for FREE [/b]👉  http://bit.ly/G4C-2021

There will be many other speakers to catch and many amazing social impact games that will be featured on the show - so if you're looking to be involved in a meaningful game event this month, look no further :D

---

And finally, during[b] #screenshotsaturday[/b], we shared a new update on a mechanic / or rather - a challenge room feature in SAMUDRA. 

You can also check out this post here:

[b]Instagram[/b] | https://www.instagram.com/p/CQ2YH6HnUjy/?utm_source=ig_web_copy_link

[b]Twitter[/b] |  https://twitter.com/Khayalan_arts/status/1411165023225860096

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36144563/2093e1556eb647fafbaddf43a58ca55214cdb82f.gif[/img]

Yes. You have the power. You have the capacity to be a good samaritan. To give mercy. To redeem the faults of all human life and save this bloated Mother-Puffer from its endless plastic prison. 

Or not. 

You can just skip these challenge rooms and go do something else. 

Probably many more important things to do than saving this 1 helpless animal that will eventually be caught later and be served as Fugu. 

Oh Idk, it probably doesn't affect any outcome anyway right? 😊

---

Thank you for taking the time to read this dev diary, we appreciate all the support!

We are a small Indie-company that makes games due to our love and passion for storytelling, art, puzzles, adventure & culture, so if you like what you see, do consider supporting us at:

[url=khayalanarts.com]Web Page[/url]

[url=https://twitter.com/Khayalan_arts]Twitter[/url]

[url=https://www.instagram.com/samudra_game/]Instagram[/url]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5H6-mR2XT3u2KvUJTU4F8w]Youtube[/url]

---

[b]#BreakUpWithPlastic[/b] 💔

- El
